description: Defines the QhullVertex class representing a vertex in Qhull's computational geometry structure, including its data members, constructors, and methods for accessing topological and geometric information.

classes.name: QhullVertex
classes.description: Represents a vertex in Qhull's geometric structure, providing access to its properties, neighbors, and related geometric data.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Returns the dimension of the hull.

methods.name: getBaseT
methods.description: Returns the base vertexT pointer for set operations.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if the vertex has a next neighbor in the linked list.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if the vertex has a previous neighbor in the linked list.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the vertex.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the vertex is valid.

methods.name: neighborFacetsDefined
methods.description: Indicates if neighbor facets are defined.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next vertex in the list.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Returns the geometric point of the vertex.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Returns the previous vertex in the list.

methods.name: qh
methods.description: Returns the Qhull context associated with the vertex.

methods.name: setVertexT
methods.description: Sets the Qhull context and vertexT pointer.

methods.name: neighborFacets
methods.description: Returns the set of neighboring facets.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Creates a printable representation of the vertex with a message.
